reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2, E3) establishes that the monolithic HfTaTiVZr and TaTiVWZr alloys exhibit dislocation-dominated creep, but it provides no data on multilayer coatings, interfaces, or the effect of interface sharpness on creep resistance. The key premises about interface blocking and comparative creep performance are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Dislocation blocking at chemically sharp, coherent interfaces suppresses time-dependent deformation
Sharp interfaces interrupt slip band formation and strain localization
Multilayers with sharp interfaces will show lower creep displacement than monolithic or diffuse-interface coatings
